_ayuda: Direcciones de arte para los diseños con IA (source 'diseno'). Rotarlas para que el perfil no se repita. 'reglas' se agrega siempre.
reglas: AVOID generic template design: no laurel leaves or botanical sprigs, no rows of circular icons, no pill-shaped buttons, no centered symmetrical flyer layout, no ribbons, no script or handwritten fonts, no clip-art ornaments, no stock 'luxury' cliches. Make bold, original art direction worthy of an award-winning design studio. Palette only: burgundy #811721, deep wine #5E0F17, cream #FCF1E1, beige #F3D8B9, muted gold #9C6A2B. Titles in a tall, narrow art-deco display typeface like the logo; small text in a clean modern sans. Spanish text spelled exactly as given and nothing else written. No prices unless given, no people, nothing sexual or suggestive. Keep key content away from the top 220 px and the bottom 300 px (Instagram UI). Vertical 9:16 for Hotel Le Chateau, Providencia, Santiago.

estilos.poster-deco: Art direction: a 1920s Art Deco travel poster in the spirit of Cassandre: strong geometric composition, flat color planes, stepped frames and radiating lines, dramatic perspective. The photo area is a tall arched or stepped window cut into the poster.
estilos.revista: Art direction: a page from a high-end interiors magazine (Kinfolk, Cereal): asymmetric grid, generous cream negative space, a huge title partly cropped by the page edge, thin gold hairlines, small editorial captions and a page number. The photo area is offset to one side, not centered.
estilos.cine: Art direction: an elegant film title card at night, like the opening credits of a classic movie: deep wine-black background with subtle film grain and light leaks, the photo area as a wide cinematic letterbox frame, title set like a film credit with generous letter spacing, one thin gold line.
estilos.suizo: Art direction: Swiss international typographic style with a warm twist: strict modular grid, big flush-left title, lots of negative space, one strong geometric burgundy shape, small numbered labels. The photo area is a clean rectangle aligned to the grid.
estilos.collage: Art direction: a refined paper collage: layered cut paper shapes in cream, burgundy and gold foil, subtle shadows between layers, an art-deco cut-out frame for the photo area, tactile but elegant.
